name: ACAP entry permit (foreigners)
notes: Tax included. Online payment adds a 2.9% gateway charge and permits issued at check-posts cost double. The Nepal Tourism Board page lists NPR 2000 per entry for foreigners, which conflicts with the issuer's figure.

name: Sagarmatha National Park entry permit (foreigners)
authority: Department of National Parks and Wildlife Conservation
notes: Himalayan Recreation states this fee for foreigners and does not say whether tax is included or whether it is per entry. The same page gives conflicting figures for the Khumbu Pasang Lhamu Rural Municipality permit (NPR 2000 in one sentence, NPR 6000 to 7000 in the next), so that permit is not recorded here.
sourceName: Himalayan Recreation Treks & Expedition (agency guide - not an official figure)

name: TIMS card (independent trekkers)
authority: Trekking Agencies Association of Nepal / Nepal Tourism Board
notes: Himalayan Recreation lists NPR 2000 for independent trekkers and NPR 1000 for group trekkers; Pokhara Info also lists NPR 2000 for individual trekkers on the Manang trek. Mardi Himal guides say TIMS is not required, so it is not linked to that trek. Requirements change, so confirm before travelling.
sourceName: Himalayan Recreation Treks & Expedition (agency guide - not an official figure)
